court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Court of Judicial Magistrate-IInd, Agra, Case No. 5086 of 2018
case_name: Pallav Goyal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Pallav Goyal and 2 others (husband, wife, plaintiff)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and another (wife's side, respondent)

facts_of_case: The parties entered into a compromise and settled their disputes to maintain harmonious relations. The applicant agreed to pay Rs.10,00,000/- to the Opposite Party No.3 in full settlement of her claims.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise can be made between parties even in respect of certain criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Wherein the Apex Court has categorically held that compromise can be made between the parties even in respect of certain criminal proceedings.
cited_cases: B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003)4 SCC 675
Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation [2008)9 SCC 677]
Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others ( 2008) 16 SCC 1
Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab (2012) 10 SCC 303
Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab ( 2014) 6 SCC 466

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to quash criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Apex Court...
cited_cases: B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003)4 SCC 675
Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation [2008)9 SCC 677]
Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others ( 2008) 16 SCC 1
Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab (2012) 10 SCC 303
Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab ( 2014) 6 SCC 466

outcome.final_order: The criminal proceedings were quashed as per the settlement deed dated 17.10.2019.
